sections.content: Use hypothetical language to compare alternatives, explain possible consequences and reflect on choices that were or were not made.

items.spanish: Si hubiera tomado otro camino, mi vida habría sido diferente.
items.english: If I had taken another path, my life would have been different.

items.spanish: Si tuviera la oportunidad, volvería a elegir este camino.
items.english: If I had the opportunity, I would choose this path again.

items.spanish: Si hubiera cambiado de dirección, quizá habría encontrado algo diferente, pero no puedo conocer todos los resultados.
items.english: If I had changed direction, I might have found something different, but I cannot know every outcome.
